changes: Contour plots: filled contours of scattered X, Y, Z points such as finite-element results, with levels, colour maps and ranges that clip at a value or a percentile.
Colour bars: beside, below or anywhere on the page, one for every panel if you like; drag the bar and its title.
Polar graphs: angle and radius around a pole, with rings, spokes and angle labels.
Fills and scales: fill the area between two plots; give a layer equal X and Y scales or no axes at all.
Plot groups: a group's colours, symbols and line styles apply to every plot in it; drag plots in the Objects tab to join or leave a group.
Worksheet and graph: type Long Name, Units and Comments in the header and the Inspector; right-click a graph for Plot Setup, Format and Rescale.
For AI assistants (MCP): graph_add_plot draws contours; graph_style sets colour bars, polar layers, equal scales and fills between plots.
